operating_protocol.name: CEREBRON-ALPHA-OMEGA
operating_protocol.limitation: Protocol use does not modify the underlying model, create new agents, or constitute evidence of self-improvement.

cognitive_weight_layer.meaning: Versioned cognitive orchestration meta-parameters, not neural model weights.

benchmark_003_r1.finding: A0 loses to neutral baseline and transfer is negative in this harness.

benchmark_004.protocol_issue: Original leakage gate had Boolean polarity error and neutral baseline was missing.

decision.reason: A1 beats A0 under equal resource budgets, but a competitive neutral verification-only baseline still beats A1 at full budget. Current harness also does not execute several claimed cognitive capabilities independently.
decision.important_inference: The A1>A0 local gain is not attributable solely to unequal compute/time allocation inside BENCH-005, but this does not establish architectural intelligence.

next_requirements: implement six genuinely distinct executable capability experiments
include matched sham controls at equal deterministic resource budgets
measure each capability with its own observable state variables and metrics
execute failure_learning, world_model, reasoning, self_improvement and metacognition rather than merely naming them
use fresh sealed task families for promotion-grade reproduction
launch 36 deterministic jobs only after the six block experiments are validated
do not equate GitHub jobs with AI agents
claim_limit: BENCH-005 rejects only a narrow resource-allocation-only explanation for the local A1>A0 result in this deterministic synthetic harness. It does not demonstrate AGI, superintelligence, autonomous self-improvement, or external generalization.
